preconditions.description: The length of the string s is at least 1 and at most 100000, and the length of the minimal unique substring is at least 1 and at most n.
The length of the string s and the length of the minimal unique substring are both even or both odd.

postconditions.description: The output string s has the specified length n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string s is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: any(s[i:i+k] == s[i]*k for i in range(len(s) - k + 1))
postconditions.description: The output string s contains at least one substring of length k that is composed of identical characters.

postconditions.expression: not any(s[i:i+k] != s[i]*k and s[i:i+k] in s[:i] for i in range(len(s) - k + 1))
postconditions.description: The output string s does not contain any substring of length k that is not composed of identical characters and appears as a substring earlier in the string.
